subject: error: "cannot open connection...no space on device"

messages.author: 00c0a415c5797cc7
messages.subject: error: "cannot open connection...no space on device"
parts:
Hi all,
I'm trying to run some code that worked a few weeks ago, but doesn't now.

I've tried reinstalling GenomicSEM and restarting R, but I get the same error.

Code:
traits <- c("h.sumstats.gz","l.sumstats.gz") sample.prev <- c(NA,NA) population.prev <- c(NA,NA) ld<-"eur_w_ld_chr/" wld <- "eur_w_ld_chr/" trait.names<-c("h","l") LDSCoutput <- ldsc(traits, sample.prev, population.prev, ld, wld, trait.names)
Error:
Error in file(paste0(log2, "_ldsc.log"), open = "wt") : cannot open the connection In addition: Warning message: In file(paste0(log2, "_ldsc.log"), open = "wt") : cannot open file 'h.sumstats.gz_l.sumstats.gz_ldsc.log': No space left on device


Has the software been updated recently? Am I doing something incorrectly? I can't munge, either. I get the same error.

Best,
Charleen

messages.subject: Re: error: "cannot open connection...no space on device"
parts:
Sorry for the trouble. It turns out that the error message is on  my end, even though others here have had similar messages. It's not GenomicSEM in this case. Someone in my lab exceeded 12T for another project, and that is what made me unable to do previous GWAS-by-Subtraction coding. (The reason I wrote the group is that I searched the conversations first and saw that some people had received similar errors messages to mine. But, in this particular instance, the issue was home-based, which I just learned.) 

Best, 
Charleen
